summary: Regression testing after major backend refactoring: (1) payroll_v2.py merged into payroll.py with consolidated routes, (2) Pydantic models centralized in /backend/models/ directory. 17/21 backend tests passed (81%). Frontend loads correctly and login successful. 4 test failures are non-critical: health endpoints (not exposed via ingress), novelty-types returns dict not list (expected), payroll-settings endpoint URL mismatch.

minor.issue: Health endpoints return HTML instead of JSON via public ingress - this is expected as they're not prefixed with /api
Endpoint URL is actually /api/payroll-settings (router has no prefix). 405 error expected at wrong URL.

critical_code_review_comments: Consolidation of payroll.py and payroll_v2.py successful - both /api/payroll (legacy_router) and /api/payroll-v2 (router) endpoints working
Centralized Pydantic models in /backend/models/ properly imported and functional
GET /api/payroll-v2/novelty-types returns a dict with 'income' and 'deduction' keys, not a list - this is the correct structure from PAYROLL_NOVELTY_TYPES constant

All critical endpoints verified working: auth/login, payroll-v2/periods, payroll-v2/payroll-types, payroll (legacy), employees, company, attendance/shifts, vacations, evaluations/cycles, accounting/accounts, reports-system/catalog
